 "data": "sequenceDiagram
 participant P as Host parent
 participant S as Image store
 participant C as Namespaced child
 participant W as Workload
 P->>S: Lock store and resolve or pull image
 S-->>P: Manifest digest and ordered lowerdirs
 P->>P: Check upper identity and chown upper
 P->>P: Private mount namespace and OverlayFS
 P->>P: Stage virtual filesystems and volumes
 P->>C: Clone with UID/GID mappings
 Note over C: Wait on cgroup start gate
 P->>P: Add child to cgroup
 P->>C: Release gate
 C->>C: Mount proc and pivot root
 C->>W: Start inspection or explicit command
 W-->>C: Exit
 C-->>P: Exit and Wait returns
 P->>P: Clean cgroup and unmount attachments
 P->>S: Release store lock
 Note over S: Image layers and tags remain stored",
 "config": null,
 "version": "12"
